purpose: Teach: 増田/古田/川上/水野/古川/桜井/平田/西田

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、参考人増田氏から、警察、事情を丁寧に伺われますね
lines.en: So the police will be taking a careful statement from the witness Masuda, I understand.
lines.style: Steady, measured cadence. Slight upward lilt at the end—not quite a question, but checking understanding. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Gentle, not accusatory.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者古田氏のご証言を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: Yes, we'll be organizing the testimony from witness Furuta thoroughly.
lines.style: Professional, clear. Warm undertone beneath official language. Slight nod in the voice—cooperative without being deferential. Even, reassuring pace.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、容疑者川上の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: And the police will be verifying Kawagami's criminal history in this case, I imagine.
lines.style: Careful, deliberate. The words land with slight weight—each fact matters. Quiet authority in the phrasing. No rush. Eyes steady on the other person.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者水野様のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: Of course. We're being very considerate toward the victim Mizuno's family in all of this.
lines.style: Gentle firmness. The word 'considerate' carries real weight—not a checkbox but a commitment. Measured, human tone. Slower on the important parts.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、現場周辺の古川氏宅の防犯映像を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: The security footage from the Furukawa residence near the scene—the police will be reviewing that as well.
lines.style: Methodical, slightly formal. The listing of details suggests careful documentation. Even pacing, with a tiny emphasis on 'security footage.' No impatience in the delivery.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者桜井さんのケアを、警察、慎重におこなわれますね
lines.en: We're handling the victim Sakurai's care with appropriate sensitivity and care.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. The repeat of 'care' isn't clumsy—it's emphasis, slow and deliberate. Professional but genuinely protective tone. No distance in the words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、参考人平田氏の供述記録を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: The witness statement records from Hirata will also be properly documented, I understand.
lines.style: Even, reflective. Slight pause before 'properly'—showing care in the phrasing. Voice carries quiet assurance. Not leading; confirming. Gentle upward inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、心理士西田氏に、警察、ご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: We're consulting with psychologist Nishida for guidance on this matter.
lines.style: Warm, direct. A hint of respect in the professional tone—reaching out for expertise without hesitation. Clear and steady. Slight openness in the phrasing, like sharing a decision.
